title: Puharich's wife's suicide
summary: Andrija Puharich tells of Puharich's wife's suicide, about late 1950s at hospital, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I received a grim call from Jenny's father.

plain: Andrija Puharich, a doctor who studied psychic phenomena, recalls a dark moment from the late 1950s. He says he got a grim call from the father of his wife, Jenny, and the story, as it is framed, is about her taking her own life, with a hospital as the setting. It is told as part of his personal life story during the years he was doing his unusual research.
